start.title: Start one reviewable coding run
start.description: Select a repository, describe the task, review permissions and budget, then create one durable queued run. Interface language, instruction language, and technical-output language remain separate.

language.switchHint: Switching the interface does not rewrite the task or technical-output policy.

repository.description: GitHub becomes the first live source adapter later. This slice uses the same provider-neutral contract with deterministic repository fixtures.

task.instructionPlaceholder: Example: Add an account settings page and keep code, branches, commits, and pull-request copy in English.

review.noBaseWrite: No direct write to the base branch.
review.sensitiveApproval: Sensitive actions remain blocked for approval.
